note: Both sets cover the same 12 facts from the baseline mission concept list and bind every value to the correct mission/component and property, with the on-axis/off-axis and baseline conditions preserved. Set A gives fuller, more verbatim quotes and binds the Lynx 10 m focal length to the mirror assembly specifically, while Set B uses ellipsized quotes and binds the focal length to Lynx generally. These are minor presentational differences; no claim in either set is misread, misbound or invented, and no important fact is missing from either.
remarks: Set B's quotes use ellipses (e.g. 'Lynx: ...three science instruments') that cut the quote short but still support the claim; Set A's quotes are fuller and would be preferable on quote fidelity alone. Set A's entity 'Lynx mirror assembly' for the 10 m focal length is slightly more precise than Set B's 'Lynx', since the page attributes the focal length to the grazing incidence mirror assembly. Both sets omit the fact that the HabEx starshade flies in formation on a separate spacecraft (partially captured in B's starshade quote) and that these are the baselines from the STDT Reports, but neither omission is significant.
